title: Supplier Returns Set Against an Interruption Claim
content:
What the suppliers have already returned, on an interruption claim under the Travel Protection Plans, is
read from the property's folio for the traveller's hotel reservation held under the Hotel Rate Plans, together
with the standing of that reservation.

## The three readings

| What the folio and the reservation show | What the suppliers have already returned |
|---|---|
| The folio carries a refund paid on the reservation, and the reservation stands checked out | The refund the property has paid |
| The folio carries property credit spent on the reservation, and the reservation stands cancelled | The property credit spent |
| Neither of those | Nothing |

Both parts of a reading must hold together: a refund on a reservation that stands cancelled rather than checked
out does not reach the first reading, and property credit spent on a reservation that stands checked out does
not reach the second.

## Points of judgement

A folio carrying both a refund paid and property credit spent, on a reservation that stands checked out, falls
under the first reading and returns the refund alone. The same folio on a reservation that stands cancelled
falls under the second and returns the property credit spent alone. A folio carrying neither, or a reservation
standing in any other state, returns nothing.
